prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Goal: A coherent THREE-BUILDING art direction comparison sheet for a modern ROBLOX mining simulator browser game. Show all three designs in ONE wide image.
Composition: Consistent eye-level three-quarter view, pale blue studio background. LARGE mining pavilion in the center, smaller upgrade shop on LEFT, smaller ore SELL kiosk on RIGHT. All three buildings fully visible, spaced apart with no overlaps, no text. Same bright soft daylight and presentation scale. No ground landscape, no characters, no UI.
Function and proportions: Central mine pavilion has a COMPLETE gabled roof, tall corner posts around a square 16m excavation opening, wide OPEN front and open sides, no floor, no central supports. Roof footprint roughly26m square; height13m; clear interior height at least7m. Both shops are about10m wide and9m high, broad open service counters, enclosed rear, no entrance stairs, one unmistakable oversized emblem each. Upgrade emblem = PICKAXE; sell emblem = GOLD COIN. Pavilion emblem = BLUE GEM. Roof emblems must be connected to the front gable, not floating.
Constraints: Modern ROBLOX simulator, NOT a generic medieval village, NOT World of Warcraft, NOT realistic carpentry, NOT gritty weathered stone, NOT thin beams, NOT ordinary garden gazebo. No tiny decorative clutter. No text, labels, logos, watermarks. Simple low-resolution-friendly materials, bold legibility.
Art direction:
CLASSIC ROBLOX MINING SIMULATOR / Mining Simulator 2: saturated cyan-blue roofs, bright ivory trims, honey yellow structural posts with simple painted surfaces, oversized faceted blue gem crest above the mine entrance, massive friendly silhouettes, thick white eave edges, golden fasteners. Upgrade shop has electric-blue roof and an oversized toy pickaxe emblem. Sell kiosk has orange roof and a giant upright gold coin emblem. Bold color coding, clean broad geometry, flat simple surface colors, soft ambient occlusion, tiny bevels. Looks like an actual modern Roblox simulator map built from polished MeshParts. Architecture proportions are delightfully exaggerated, no realistic wood grain.

ROBLOX PET SIMULATOR / toy collectible style: inflated broad architectural trims, compact candy-colored buildings, smooth saturated sky-blue roofs, creamy white pillowy pillars and small golden feet, huge sparkling blue gem emblem on the mine roof, huge crossed blue-and-gold toy pickaxes above upgrade shop, giant shiny gold coin disc above sell shop.
